metadata.llm_reason: Candidate is a distinct, foundational skill for D3 scale selection and configuration that covers the full decision tree (data type → scale type → domain/range mapping). While peer_candidates include related skills (module selection, shape rendering, sequential scale configuration), this skill uniquely addresses the critical upstream task of choosing the correct scale type before specialization. No redundancy detected; the sequential scale skill is a narrower specialization of this broader capability. Support evidence confirms relevance to D3 documentation.
